name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: Resolution on the devastating floods in central and eastern Europe, the loss of lives and the EU’s preparedness to act on such disasters exacerbated by climate change
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is asking the European Union to help the countries hit by the September 2024 floods in central and eastern Europe, and to prepare better for future disasters. It wants faster emergency aid, more money for rescue services and recovery, and stronger steps to adapt to climate change, such as restoring flood plains and improving early warning systems.

- The Parliament asks for quick EU money and rescue help for Austria, Czechia, Germany, Hungary, Poland, Romania and Slovakia.
- It calls for more funding for EU disaster response and recovery, and for flood prevention and climate adaptation.
- Next, the Commission and member states decide whether to act on these requests; the resolution itself changes no law.
